The '''''Raider''''' was the [[GS-100 salvage ship/Legends|GS-100 salvage ship]] that belonged to the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Ratch/Legends|Ratch]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Raider_nose_art.jpg|thumb|left|160px|''Raider''{{'s}} nose art]]

This [[Starship/Legends|ship]] had nose art of a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] with [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] lettering meaning "Raider" on both sides.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], after the [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|battle]] of the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]], the ''Raider'' was searching for valuable items in the aftermath debris. There, they found unconscious [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] within her damaged [[Ginivex-class starfighter/Legends|''Ginivex''-class starfighter]] and retrieved them into the ship. Though [[Ratch/Legends|Ratch]] and his [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] crew attempted to get ransom for her from her master, they were killed by Ventress. Later, ''Raider'' was used by Ventress to return her original home [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] also used this ship to send three of their [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], Ventress, [[Karis/Legends|Karis]], and [[Naa'leth/Legends|Naa'leth]] to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Dooku's palace/Legends|palace]] on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]].
